verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes praat samai isanaan kar jihavaa japat gurma(n)tr jaise jaanahee ||

en.bdb: The obedient Sikhs of the True Guru bathe themselves in the ambrosial hour, sit in meditation and recitation of Lord's name as they know and as taught to them by the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਪਾਇ ਪਰਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: tilak lilaar pai parat parasapar sabadh sunai gai sun unamaan hee ||

en.bdb: In the congregation of the Sikhs of the Guru, they shower respect and love upon each, sing, listen and reflect on Lord's praises while the marks of acceptance of such acts become conspicuous on their forehead.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਜਨ ਤਜਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat bhajan tajan dhuramat kahai giaan dhiaan gursikh pa(n)ch paravaan hee ||

en.bdb: The path of Guru's wisdom teaches us adopting and practicing Guru's teachings and shedding base wisdom. Guru-blessed knowledge and concentrating mind on the True Guru is only acceptable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਉ ਕਹਤ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਭਲੋ ਰਹਤ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਹੀ ॥੬੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: dhekhat sunat aau kahat sab kouoo bhalo rahat a(n)taragat satigur maanahee ||613||

en.bdb: Outwardly, everyone sees, listens to and describes this Guru defined path. But those who have adopted this path innately are accepted ultimately at the door of the True Guru.
